sense: one person’s account of what happened

evidence: Cic. de Or. 2.80: ut vērī similis narrātiō sit (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: the story as people tell it
terms.comment: duplex fāma est, there are two versions of the story.

phrases.latin: duplex inde fāma est: aliī proeliō victum Latīnum pācem cum Aenēā, deinde affīnitātem jūnxisse trādunt
phrases.english: from here there are two versions: some say that Latinus, beaten in battle, made peace with Aeneas and then an alliance by marriage

sources: Lewis & Short: narratio · Lewis & Short: fama
Livy 1 and 29 checked against the Perseus Latin texts (9 November 2026).
Citations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them and have not been checked against an edition.
